applies_why: The judge text makes the two admitted readings of Matthew 1:16 the reason to mark the line UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. Readings weighed: (1) both senses stand, so the verse is not open; (2) admitting two senses makes the line UNDERDETERMINED.
why: K-S2 forbids treating a verse that carries two senses as open or underdetermined, and the judge did so.
